items.title: DoJ Seizes $2.8 Million in Crypto From Zeppelin Ransomware Operators
items.description: The U.S. Department of Justice (DoJ) announced the seizure of over $2.8 million in cryptocurrency, $70,000 in cash, and a luxury vehicle linked to Zeppelin ransomware operations. The warrants were unsealed on August 14, 2025, in federal courts across Virginia, California, and Texas.
